instruction: Open Chrome's search engine settings to view and manage your default search provider.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome search engine settings. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric to check if the active tab URL matches chrome://settings/searchEngines. Similar complexity to original task - single navigation action to Chrome internal settings page.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the single requirement: opening Chrome search engine settings page
Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) can extract the active tab URL from Chrome's address bar via accessibility tree
Metric (is_expected_active_tab_approximate) correctly compares URLs while ignoring query parameters, which is appropriate for settings pages
Expected URL 'chrome://settings/searchEngines' is the correct Chrome internal page for search engine settings
Config uses empty goto_prefix which is correct for chrome:// internal URLs
Logic flow is sound: getter extracts URL → metric compares → returns 1.0 if match, 0.0 otherwise
No postconfig needed as verification happens immediately after task completion while Chrome is still open
